compositionEvidence.summary: Final assembly uses accepted WebGPU-safe parts as a layered Favre-like matte graphic field: dark void, transformed grid, radial anchors, profile silhouettes, stripe/cord rhythm, Anderlecht diagonals, and restrained red heat cue.
decisions: Retained the canonical composition camera because isolated and cumulative preview evidence showed readable forms from the same distance envelope; no pre-preview evidence justified a noncanonical lens change.
Set environment radius to 42 to preserve accepted part preview scale and prevent the all-over field from becoming a cropped wall of oversized marks.
Kept motion as optional steady-grid-pulse with captureMode frozen by the accepted modules; no new animation metaphor was introduced.
Used only renderer-owned outputColorTransform for subtle exposure/saturation/contrast; no module helper or WebGL post-processing assumption was added.

takeaways: Camera ownership is explicit and projection stays canonical unless preview evidence proves failure.
Output grade is kept as one renderer-owned final transform rather than compensating stacked material/post changes.
Preview handoff relies on deterministic fixed camera, frozen capture time, desktop/mobile screenshots, render reports, and WebGPU feature facts.
